Title: LLMs.txt Generator for Umbraco
Description: Build your /llms.txt from the Umbraco backoffice. Editors compose it from blocks: text, headings, links to Umbraco pages or external URLs, and sections that list the pages under a node, optionally with all descendants, filtered by depth, document type, hidden pages and a page limit. One file per site/domain, follows the llmstxt.org format, live preview while editing, regenerated automatically when content is published. Dashboard in English and Danish.
